description: Background Music turns a short description into instrumental music that plays right inside your chat. Ask for a vibe: "smoky Japanese jazz," "upbeat Berlin techno," or "lo-fi for focus" and it generates a fresh instrumental track and plays it in an embedded player, generating continuous music for about an hour. Every track is fully instrumental (no vocals) and generated on the spot with Google's AI music model; nothing is pulled from a catalog. All audio is AI-generated and carries an inaudible SynthID watermark. There are no accounts and no sign-up. Add the connector, ask for a vibe, and press play.

defaultPrompt: Put on lo-fi beats to help me focus
